reading.body:
Critical equipment lead times track order-to-delivery time for transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling plant, and high-end accelerators.

Transformer and switchgear lead times are described as having stretched from months to years, now gating construction schedules as hard as permits do, which places physical equipment supply on equal footing with regulatory approval as a bottleneck on new capacity, a detail that complicates any narrative that treats data center buildout delays as purely a permitting or grid-connection problem. Lead-time surveys are published by industry groups and research firms, and the site directs readers to those sources rather than republishing specific figures.

Its siblings, hyperscaler and colocation capital expenditure and colocation rental rates, are grouped under Financials and supply chain, together tracking spending, pricing, and physical delivery time as three faces of the same capacity constraint.
